_comment: One line per scene. Each says what its scene shows and no more -- the narration is held to the same rule as the captions, so a listener who cannot read the screen is told the same truths, including what is mock and what is not built. `lead` is seconds after the cut before the voice starts.

lines.What: CostHub. One dashboard for cloud spend across accounts that were never an Organization.
lines.Why: Before, every account reported on its own, and access was all or nothing. Now there is one place to look.
lines.See: Spend by account, by service, and by period. This is sample data, not live spend.
lines.Who: One person sees every account. Another sees only what they were granted, because the database never returns the rest.
lines.Real: It is connected to a real account. When another one cannot be read yet, it says exactly why.
lines.Run: One command deploys it. There are no servers to patch, and it watches its own bill.
lines.Next: Next: Azure, Google Cloud, sources like Databricks, and alerts that reach the right people.
lines.Close: CostHub. Cost data people can share without over-sharing.
